worlds.name: The Modern World of the Aurelius Dynasty
worlds.type: Modern setting · Corporate and family drama
worlds.summary: A fictional contemporary world with realistic technology, education, finance, transportation, medicine and corporate institutions. Its power structures are shaped by global dynasties, multinational businesses, national elites, professional institutions and ordinary communities. There is no magic, supernatural system or hidden fantasy society.
worlds.geography: The story moves between the Valmont family's home, the Aurelius ancestral estate, Elena's first independent apartment, an elite international university and the Aurelius Global headquarters. The country and city names remain to be established consistently before they are used in the story.
worlds.history: Eighteen years before the main story, a newborn exchange at a hospital, falsified records and concealed evidence separated Elena from the Aurelius family. The incident was never properly resolved. The Aurelius family continued searching while Elena grew up in the Valmont household. The DNA revelation and Isabelle's return expose only part of the original mystery.

powerHierarchy.title: Global dynasties
powerHierarchy.description: Internationally influential families with enormous corporate empires and cross-border business relationships. The Aurelius family belongs to this level.

powerHierarchy.title: International business families
powerHierarchy.description: Wealthy families controlling multinational corporations and substantial investment portfolios.

powerHierarchy.title: National elite families
powerHierarchy.description: Powerful domestic industrialists, investors and business groups. The Valmont family is among the most influential at this level.

powerHierarchy.title: Regional business families
powerHierarchy.description: Successful local and regional enterprises with influence in their markets.

powerHierarchy.title: Professional elite
powerHierarchy.description: Leading doctors, lawyers, academics, specialists and executives whose expertise carries institutional influence.

powerHierarchy.title: General population
powerHierarchy.description: Ordinary working and middle-class people whose lives and perspectives remain part of the wider world.

locations.name: Valmont Estate
locations.description: Elena's childhood home: a mansion with private gardens, guest residences, a library, swimming pool, formal dining rooms and extensive grounds. It represents her old life and the relationships she gradually loses.

locations.name: Aurelius Estate
locations.description: The ancestral residence of the Aurelius dynasty, with multiple residential wings, private gardens, a family library, guesthouses, an indoor swimming pool, security facilities and a private medical centre. Elena's original bedroom has been preserved.

locations.name: Elena's First Apartment
locations.description: A modest apartment arranged after Elena leaves the Valmont estate. It gives her a private space where she can make her own decisions and begin building an independent life.

locations.name: International University
locations.description: An elite university attended by members of wealthy families, scholarship students and academically exceptional people. Elena's education and friendships become important to her independent life.

locations.name: Aurelius Global Headquarters
locations.description: The central headquarters of the Aurelius business empire and the centre of major corporate storylines.

organizations.name: Aurelius Properties
organizations.description: Commercial real estate and luxury developments.

organizations.name: Valmont Group
organizations.description: A substantial national business group with interests in manufacturing, real estate, retail and domestic finance.

timeline.title: The newborn exchange
timeline.date: Eighteen years before the main story
timeline.description: A hospital incident involving a newborn exchange, falsified records and concealed evidence separates Elena from the Aurelius family.

timeline.title: Elena grows up in the Valmont household
timeline.description: Elena is raised as the youngest Valmont daughter while the Aurelius family continues searching for its missing child.

timeline.title: The DNA revelation
timeline.description: A DNA examination identifies Isabelle as the biological Valmont daughter and begins the breakdown of Elena's place in the household.

timeline.title: Elena leaves the Valmont estate
timeline.description: After being gradually marginalised, Elena accepts an apartment and allowance and leaves without begging the family to keep her.

timeline.title: The Aurelius family finds Elena
timeline.description: The long-running investigation finally identifies the missing Aurelius daughter, setting the family reunion and the deeper hospital mystery in motion.

narrativeRules: Business influence must be demonstrated through credible ownership, market relationships and institutional power, not repeated claims about wealth.
The hospital mystery must be resolved through evidence and investigation.
Family reunions and trust must develop gradually.
Family affection, friendships, personal ambitions and consequences are central; romance is excluded.

worlds.name: The Kingdom of Elarion
worlds.summary: Elarion is an old and prosperous monarchy with a layered aristocratic hierarchy, extensive trade networks, established magical institutions and a long history of political conflict. Its wealth is unevenly distributed, its bureaucracy is inefficient, and powerful families profit from preserving outdated arrangements. Society ranges from the royal household and great dukes to lesser nobles, merchants, guild workers, farmers, craftsmen and ordinary citizens. Daily life includes markets, schools, festivals, household management, transportation, food production, education and village administration. Magic is a structured discipline built on mana, magic circuits and catalysts. Ability varies between individuals; complex spells require training and preparation, large workings need several practitioners or specialised structures, excessive mana use causes exhaustion and circuit damage, and magical infrastructure requires regular maintenance. Healing magic cannot replace medicine, surgery or ordinary healthcare.

powerHierarchy.title: Royal Crown
powerHierarchy.description: The monarch and royal household hold the highest formal authority, though royal decisions are constrained by law, custom, the council and powerful regional interests.

powerHierarchy.title: Great Nobility
powerHierarchy.description: Dukes and other major nobles control extensive lands, regional administrations, resources and private forces. House Veyr is among the kingdom’s most influential ducal families.

powerHierarchy.title: Lesser Nobility
powerHierarchy.description: Counts, viscounts, barons and landed houses administer smaller territories, collect lawful dues and maintain local obligations.

powerHierarchy.title: Merchant and Guild Powers
powerHierarchy.description: Merchant families, trade guilds and manufacturing interests influence prices, supply networks, commercial regulation and employment.

powerHierarchy.title: Religious and Professional Institutions
powerHierarchy.description: The Holy Church, Royal Academy, healers, scholars, engineers and other specialists provide services and expertise while maintaining their own institutional interests.

powerHierarchy.title: The General Population
powerHierarchy.description: Farmers, workers, craftsmen, traders and village communities form the foundation of the kingdom’s economy and experience the practical consequences of policy.

locations.name: Aurelion — Royal Capital
locations.description: Seat of the monarchy, royal council, aristocratic residences and central administration. Political rivalries, public expenditure and competing court factions shape the capital’s daily life.

locations.name: Veyr — Northern Duchy
locations.description: The home territory of House Veyr, rich in agricultural land, minerals and natural resources. Its recurring challenges include winter shortages, roads and bridges, storage capacity and inherited financial mismanagement.

locations.name: Merrow — Eastern Territories
locations.description: A major commercial and manufacturing region whose prosperity depends on trade routes, workshops and merchant agreements. Monopolies, labour conditions and outdated commercial rules are persistent concerns.

locations.name: Solmere — Southern Provinces
locations.description: A region known for agriculture, medicine and religious institutions. Unequal taxation, medical supplies and rural poverty affect communities beyond its prosperous towns.

locations.name: Ashenford — Western Marches
locations.description: Strategic border territories containing military installations, transport routes and magical research facilities. Security, logistics and unstable magical infrastructure require sustained attention.

locations.name: The Royal Academy
locations.description: A prestigious institution for magical education and research. Its laboratories, funding arrangements, staff hierarchy and maintenance systems are as important to its success as the talent of its scholars.

organizations.name: Royal Crown
organizations.description: The monarchy and royal household, exercising national executive authority within the kingdom’s political and legal constraints.

organizations.name: Royal Council
organizations.description: The central body responsible for coordinating government administration, policy and the work of royal ministries.

organizations.name: Aristocratic Houses
organizations.description: Noble families that hold land, administer regions, maintain household institutions and participate in royal and local governance.

organizations.name: Merchant Guilds
organizations.description: Commercial organisations that regulate trade, negotiate privileges, coordinate crafts and transport, and sometimes protect entrenched monopolies.

organizations.name: Holy Church
organizations.description: Religious administration and charitable institutions, including the saintess’s public service and community work.

organizations.name: Royal Academy
organizations.description: The kingdom’s principal institution for magical education, scholarship, research and the training of specialists.

organizations.name: Royal Military
organizations.description: The kingdom’s defence forces, responsible for national security, border installations, transport and military supply.
